title: Dual-path compatibility validator + replay capture harness for streaming, toolcalls, and structured outputs
creator: Sara Kim
description: Problem: Past deprecations and behavioral flag changes caused subtle regressions in streaming boundaries, function-call argument shapes, and structured output schemas that were only detected in production. Goal: Build a dual-path validator and replay capture harness that (1) runs inputs against both old (legacy) and new (candidate) API paths in parallel, (2) captures full streaming traces, tool-call invocations, and structured outputs, (3) computes semantic and structural divergence signals, and (4) provides automated regression gates and a replayable corpus for root-cause analysis. Deliver a standalone harness and CI integration so teams can opt into compatibility checks before rolling flags or versioned changes to customers.
acceptance_criteria: A dual-path test runner that can target two API endpoints (hosted vX and candidate vY) and record interleaved streaming events for the same request ID
Automated semantic divergence metrics: token divergence, ROUGE/BLEU-like heuristics, embedding similarity thresholding, and tool-call outcome equivalence checks
Replay corpus with 10k real and synthetic prompts, labeled by pattern (streaming-only, function-call-heavy, structured-output), and a way to replay at scale against a candidate deployment
CI hook that blocks a flags rollout when regression signals exceed configured thresholds (false positive tolerance configurable per project)
Storage of captured traces and replayer manifests in a queryable location (S3 path + index) with links surfaced in the Console job result
Runbook for rollback and customer-facing mitigation steps drafted and reviewed by Product and Support
tasks: Design dual-path API interface and request correlation model (request_id + replay_id)
Implement streaming trace capture (granular events: token emission, chunk boundaries, cancel/timeout) for both paths
Instrument function/tool-calls: capture tool name, args, return values, and side-effects snapshot
Develop semantic comparator: token-diff, embedding-similarity, schema-equality checks for structured outputs
Create replay engine that can re-run captures deterministically with time acceleration options
Build CI integration and dashboard link generator for Console
Produce evaluation corpus: sampling from production (anonymized) + fuzz generator for edge cases
Draft runbook and coordinate security review for captured PII and KMS handling

test_plan_summary: Run the replay harness against nightly candidate builds. For each capture: replay against legacy and candidate paths, compute divergence signals, and surface aggregates. Flag regressions when (embedding_similarity < 0.88 AND token_divergence_score > 0.12) OR structured_schema_violations > 0. Thresholds adjustable per project. Include randomized fuzz replays at 2x traffic for stress-testing ordering and backpressure behavior.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Capturing live traffic could include sensitive data. Mitigation: capture sampling, automated PII scrubber, encryption-at-rest (customer-managed KMS), and security review. Risk: False positives due to non-deterministic model outputs. Mitigation: use relaxed semantic thresholds, deterministic seeds for model sampling where possible, and filter known nondeterministic patterns before gating rollouts.
